options.content:
## Checkout service health

Traffic, errors and latency for the HTTP tier. Paging runbook: [checkout on-call](https://runbooks.example.com/checkout).

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Number of HTTP requests served in the window.

query.sql: SELECT count(*) AS requests FROM http_requests

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Share of requests that returned a 5xx status, as a percentage.

query.sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status >= 500) / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS error_pct FROM http_requests

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request duration in milliseconds, with its per-minute history.

query.sql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95_ms FROM http_requests GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

panels.title: CPU by host
panels.description: Average CPU utilization per host over the window, as a percentage.

query.sql: SELECT host, avg(cpu_pct) AS cpu FROM host_metrics GROUP BY host ORDER BY host

panels.title: Requests and errors per minute
panels.description: Requests and 5xx responses counted per one-minute bucket.

query.sql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, count(*) AS requests, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status >= 500) AS errors FROM http_requests GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: Median and 95th percentile request duration in milliseconds, per minute.

query.sql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p50_ms, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95_ms FROM http_requests GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute

panels.title: Bytes served
panels.description: Response bytes summed per five-minute bucket, from the per-minute rollup.

query.sql: SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', minute) AS bucket, sum(bytes_sum) AS bytes FROM http_requests_1m GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Busiest routes
panels.description: Request count per route, the ten busiest.

query.sql: SELECT route, count(*) AS requests FROM http_requests GROUP BY route ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Responses by status class
panels.description: Share of responses per status class (2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx).

query.sql: SELECT (status / 100)::text || 'xx' AS status_class, count(*) AS responses FROM http_requests GROUP BY status_class ORDER BY status_class

panels.title: Slowest routes
panels.description: Request count and 95th percentile duration per route, slowest first.

query.sql: SELECT route, count(*) AS requests, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95_ms FROM http_requests GROUP BY route ORDER BY p95_ms DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Traffic by route over time
panels.description: Request count per route per five-minute bucket.

query.sql: SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', ts) AS bucket, route, count(*) AS requests FROM http_requests GROUP BY bucket, route ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Response size against latency
panels.description: Average response bytes against average duration in milliseconds, one point per route.

query.sql: SELECT avg(bytes) AS avg_bytes, avg(duration_ms) AS avg_ms, route FROM http_requests GROUP BY route

panels.title: Service status
panels.description: Each service's state over time, one lane per service.

query.sql: SELECT ts, service, state FROM service_status ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Recent errors and warnings
panels.description: The newest lines at warn or above; expand one for its request id.

query.sql: SELECT ts, level, message, service, request_id FROM app_logs WHERE level IN ('error', 'warn') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200
